rows.grounds: first member of color compound describing the line
second member of compound indicating color quality
indeclinable suffix forming comparison with prior manner
imperative instruction to perform the drawing action

items.question: What specific color and manner must characterize the line to be drawn?
premises: The line is described as black-colored.
The line is also described as white.
The action must follow the manner established before.
items.inference: One must make a white line that is black-colored in the same manner as before.
uncertainties: The precise visual relation between black-colored and white in describing the same line is context-dependent.
items.plain_english: Make a white line, black in color, just as before.
